items: [Dog Crate Furniture for 2 Large Dogs] Designed for multi-dog households, this 62-inch dog crate furniture provides a spacious and comfortable indoor space for 2 large dogs. The double-compartment layout helps keep each dog secure and relaxed while allowing this double dog crate to blend naturally into your home as functional furniture.

[100% Solid Wood with Heavy Duty Construction] Crafted from 100% solid wood, this heavy duty dog crate furniture is built for long-lasting daily use. Compared with ordinary wire kennels or flimsy wood alternatives, this solid wood indoor dog kennel offers enhanced stability, durability, and a stronger furniture-grade structure for large breeds.

[Removable Divider for Flexible Use] Featuring a removable divider, this double dog crate furniture can be used as two separate spaces for 2 dogs or converted into one larger area when needed. Whether you have 2 large dogs, a growing dog, or changing household needs, this indoor dog kennel gives you flexible setup options.

[Sliding Door Design with TV Stand Function] The sliding door dog crate design makes daily use more convenient while saving surrounding space compared with traditional swing doors. With its wide and sturdy top, this dog crate TV stand also works as a practical furniture piece for displaying décor, storing essentials, or serving as an accent table in your living room.

[Vintage Industrial Style for Indoor Living] Blending vintage industrial style with practical pet care, this wooden dog crate furniture features a furniture-style appearance that complements living rooms, bedrooms, and entryways. More than just a dog kennel indoor, it is a decorative dog crate furniture piece designed to match your home while giving your dogs a secure place to rest.
